column1: # Six literal-tab-separated fields. Replace every example before use.
# group label ssh_aliases remote_path local_path mode
# SSH aliases must already be configured and host keys independently verified.
# The perception remote path must be an existing active mountpoint on each relay.
# Relative paths and ~/ paths resolve from each relay account's own home.
# No passwords, tokens, private keys, hostnames, or account identifiers belong here.
